title: filter_transactions
description: Narrow the currently shown transaction list so the charge the customer is describing becomes easy to find and is highlighted. Fill the fields progressively as the customer gives them — naming only an amount filters by amount alone and leaves the date unset, and a later turn can add the date. An empty invocation clears the filter and shows the whole list again. This only changes what is shown; it selects nothing and disputes nothing.

amount.description: Approximate transaction amount in the account's currency, e.g. 240 for 'about two hundred and forty dollars'. Matching is fuzzy; an approximate value is expected.

date.description: Transaction date as YYYY-MM-DD, resolved from a relative phrase like 'last Tuesday' against today's date.

merchant.description: Merchant name or fragment the customer recalls, e.g. 'Riverside'. Matching is case-insensitive and partial.
